visual_action: The video opens on the back of a grey Toyota Prius covered in bumper stickers, stopped at an intersection. It cuts to the interior, showing two lethargic-looking people with blue hair and piercings. The scene shifts to a close-up of a finger pressing an 'auto start-stop off' button in a different car. A red sports car, driven by a blonde woman, pulls up beside the Prius. The two people in the Prius look over. The red sports car then accelerates rapidly, leaving the Prius far behind as it slowly begins to move. The final shot shows the red car speeding down the road.
